fields.label: Department
fields.note: Rendered as department groups on the official careers page; the Ashby posting API returns the whole board and filters client-side.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: Ashby board location filter; not accepted by the public posting API (?q= returned the full board).

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: From posting-api employmentType; no separate employment-type control is sent to the API.

notes: Official careers page embeds the Ashby board (organization Supabase). The public posting API GET https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/supabase?includeCompensation=true returns all 71 listed jobs with department, location, employmentType and publishedAt; ?q=engineer returned all 71 plus two new postings, so no server-side keyword/facet filtering. Keyword and filters must be applied locally.
